provenance-or-nothing.statement: A number that cannot cite its source does not render. Every published claim carries a permanent machine-checkable address, the formula reference that produced it, and its gate state; primary registries outrank media; the method itself is published so the reader can disagree with the method rather than the data.

deterministic-code-owns-numbers.statement: Every count, score, sum and rank is computed by reviewable deterministic code. A language model may name, summarize and interpret — it never authors a figure, and any numeric claim in generated prose must re-derive from the store or it does not render.

missing-is-not-zero.statement: An absent value is a different fact from a measured zero. Rendering "0 speeches" for a person whose speech data was never ingested is a fabricated claim. Every metric carries its coverage; "not measured" and "not applicable" are first-class states, and nothing missing ever loses a comparison.

disclose-never-repair.statement: Bad source data — an impossible date, a broken row, a header drift — is suppressed and counted, never silently corrected. A repaired value is an invented value. The reader is told what was withheld and why; the source keeps the blame.

non-partisan-symmetry.statement: The method covers the whole population or covers nothing — a shortlist is an editorial act. Absence of a conflict is a finding with equal claim to surface; scandals are neither manufactured nor softened, across all parties identically.

lead-not-finding.statement: Automated matches, web research, model verdicts and tripwires produce candidates for human review. Coincidence in time or registry is a fact; substantive connection requires human verification and until then must not be asserted anywhere. Machine review is not human review, and the copy must say which one happened.

incident-anchored-doctrine.statement: A rule is recorded with the measured failure that produced it — date, counts, what was published wrongly and for how long. A rule with its incident attached resists erosion; a rule stated as a principle invites re-litigation. When a rule keeps being violated, stop restating it and give it an observable output.

one-definition-one-import.statement: A rule that exists twice will drift, and in this domain every measured drift favored a named person or firm. Thresholds, weights, vocabularies and formulas live in exactly one place and are imported by every consumer — a restated literal is a future lie.

every-cap-ships-its-population.statement: A top-N list, a truncated read, or a sampled check states the size of what it was drawn from. A capped corpus yields a floor, not a total; a silent truncation reads as "everything" when it is not.
